title: Samsung, SK hynix Buying Share Hits 45%, Triples in a Year - Seoul Economic Daily
snippet: Samsung, SK hynix Buying Share Hits 45%, Triples in a Year  Seoul Economic Daily

triage.summary: Samsung and SK hynix combined market share in memory semiconductors has reached 45%, tripling over the past year. This reflects significant consolidation and competitive positioning among two major fund holdings, indicating material shifts in the memory market structure.
